{{recipesummary|category=Fish recipes|servings=4|time=¾ hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Fish|Fish]]

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Flounder|flounder]] or other flat [[Cookbook:Fish|fish]] fillets
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dry [[Cookbook:Wine|vermouth]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (¼ stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] wedges

==Procedure==
# At least 20 minutes before you plan to cook, preheat [[Cookbook:Broil|broiler]].
# Lightly oil bottom of a 9x13-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|ovenproof dish]].
# Arrange fillets in a single layer in the dish.
# Pour in vermouth, using only enough to be about ½ inch deep.
# Put pan under broiler and [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] the fish as close to the heat as possible for about 2 minutes.
# Remove and quickly spread softened butter over the fillets.
# Return the pan to the broiler and cook for about 5 minutes more, until fish is just cooked through.
# Remove fish from the broiler.
# Salt and pepper each fillet and serve it with lemon wedges.
